description: RACE: lease create then send-manifest with NO settle/confirm wait. Line 86 broadcasts `tx market lease create` then line 88 IMMEDIATELY runs send-manifest. lease create is an on-chain tx that must be committed in a block (~6s) AND the provider must observe the lease before it will accept a manifest. Sending the manifest the same instant the lease tx is broadcast will frequently get 'no lease for that deployment'/'lease not found' from the provider -> send-manifest fails -> fail-closed, even though the lease will exist a few seconds later. There is no poll/retry on send-manifest analogous to the bid poll. Also lease create uses `-y` with `>/dev/null 2>&1`, so a tx that broadcasts but FAILS in the block (non-zero code) is not detected — only client-side broadcast errors are caught.

evidence.snippet:
"$PS" tx market lease create ... || { ...; exit 1; }
"$PS" send-manifest "$SDL_FILE" --dseq "$DSEQ" --provider "$PROVIDER" ... || { ...; exit 1; }

correctFix: After lease create, confirm the lease is active (`query market lease list --owner $ADDR --dseq $DSEQ -o json | jq -e '.leases[]|select(.lease.state=="active")'`) in a short poll, OR retry send-manifest a few times with a 2-3s backoff. Verify the lease-create tx result code is 0 (use --output json and check .code==0 / .raw_log) rather than discarding output.
